title: 第13章 复姓端木单字一个斋第14章 别等了人来不了
content_zh:
进入刘家宅院那条巷子时，有几个巡检司的巡卒，跟人发生了争执。
陆天明一瘸一拐走过去，找人打听。
原来是巡卒要查案，杨家家丁堵着不让进。
巡检司今天没回来多少人，他们不敢造次。
而且杨员外有钱，他的面子多多少少还是要给的。
陆天明推着车走过去，家丁们没阻拦，直接放人。
有巡卒不快道：“你们干什么？当差的不给进，一个瘸子随随便便就放过去？”
家丁们没搭理，手上推的更狠了。
陆天明回头，在那几个巡卒脸上打量。
“看什么看死瘸子，早晚有一天，劳资把你弄进牢里好好收拾。”
说话这人，陆天明认识。
当初跟他一块在于勇手底下要账。
后来竞争不过陆天明，便没干了。
陆天明没搭理，转头推着车往深处走。
走到深处，出现一个少女，杨家二小姐。
杨二小姐年关后才成年，可已经出落得美丽大方。
“秀才，大宝哥情况如何？”杨二小姐拦住陆天明。
“还有一口气吊着。”陆天明答道。
少女开始抽泣，鼻涕淌到嘴角，很没形象的用袖子擦干净。
连擦鼻涕都这么好看，难怪刘大宝一直惦记。

没有过多言语，陆天明脚步不停，进了刘家大院。
“叔，大宝醒过没？”
床榻前，陆天明用湿毛巾给刘大宝擦拭嘴角的血迹。
“醒过一次，见你没在，又昏过去了。”
刘能面如土色，憔悴不已。
“叔，今晚我看着大宝，明儿会有大夫过来。”
刘能叹道：“哎，镇上这些大夫，能力我知道，即便敢来，大宝这伤也不好治。”
陆天明没说话。
他找大夫，也只是死马当活马医而已。
还没等到天亮，大夫就来了。
人长得不出彩，左边脸颊有跟带毛的痦子。
“你就是二娘说的陆天明？”
大夫一边给刘大宝查看伤情，一边问道。
陆天明点头：“嗯，大夫，您贵姓？”
“复姓端木，单名一个斋，你可以叫我毛哥。”
说话间，端木斋手一翻，十几根银针插得刘大宝满头都是。
也没见端木斋怎么发力，银针便自然颤动。
“回魂十三针，听过没？”
content_en:
When entering the alley of Liu's house, several patrolmen from the inspection department got into a dispute with someone.
Lu Tianming limped over and asked someone to inquire.
It turned out that the patrol wanted to investigate the case, but the Yang family's servants blocked him from entering.
Not many people from the Inspection Department came back today, so they didn't dare to make any mistakes.
Moreover, since Yang Yuanwai is rich, he still needs to give him more or less face.
Lu Tianming pushed the cart and walked over. The servants did not stop him and let him go.
A patrolman asked angrily: "What are you doing? You don't let the servants in, but you let a lame man pass by casually?"
The servants ignored him and pushed him harder.
Lu Tianming turned around and looked at the faces of the patrolmen.
"What are you looking at to see you dead? Sooner or later, labor and management will put you in jail and take care of you."
Lu Tianming knew the person he was speaking to.
I went with him to collect the debt from Yu Yongshou.
Later, he couldn't compete with Lu Tianming, so he stopped working.
Lu Tianming ignored him and turned around to push the car deeper.
Walking deeper, a girl appeared, the second young lady of the Yang family.
Miss Yang Er only came of age in her later years, but she is already beautiful and generous.
"Xiucai, how is Brother Dabao doing?" Miss Yang Er stopped Lu Tianming.
"There is still one breath left." Lu Tianming replied.
The girl began to sob, and snot dripped from her nose to the corner of her mouth, and she wiped it off with her sleeve in an inconspicuous manner.
Even wiping his nose looks so good, no wonder Liu Dabao has been thinking about it.
Without saying much, Lu Tianming walked into the Liu family courtyard without stopping.
"Uncle, has Dabao woke up?"
In front of the bed, Lu Tianming wiped the blood from the corners of Liu Dabao's mouth with a wet towel.
"I woke up once, saw you weren't there, and passed out again."
Liu Neng's face was earthy and haggard.
"Uncle, I will watch Dabao tonight. A doctor will come over tomorrow."
Liu Neng sighed: "Hey, I know the abilities of these doctors in this town. Even if they dare to come, Dabao's injury will not be easy to cure."
Lu Tianming said nothing.
When he went to see a doctor, he was just treating a dead horse as a live doctor.
Before dawn, the doctor came.
The man is not good-looking and has a hairy mole on his left cheek.
"Are you the Lu Tianming that Er Niang said?"
The doctor asked while checking Liu Dabao's injuries.
Lu Tianming nodded: "Well, doctor, what is your surname?"
"The compound surname is Duanmu, and the single name is Yizhai. You can call me Brother Mao."
As he spoke, Duanmuzhai turned his hand, and more than a dozen silver needles were inserted all over Liu Dabao's head.
No matter how hard Duanmuzhai exerted his force, the silver needle trembled naturally.
"Thirteen stitches to restore the soul, have you heard of it?"
